name: UQ Laptop Grant
summary: Financial assistance for UQ students whose laptop is damaged, broken or needs repair, so they can keep studying.
who: UQ students whose laptop is damaged, broken, or in need of repair.
how: Complete the Financial Assistance Application and include details about your laptop issue.
catches: UQ also runs a separate Student Laptop Loans program.

source.label: UQ: apply for financial hardship assistance

evidence.quote: If your laptop is damaged, broken, or in need of repair, you may be eligible for a Laptop Grant
To apply, simply complete the Financial Assistance Application and include details about your laptop issue.
